title: Should Homework Be Banned?
text:
In many schools, teachers assign homework every evening. Supporters argue that homework helps students practise what they learn in class and develop discipline. However, critics claim that long assignments reduce the time children need for rest, sports, and family life. This debate has led some education experts to question whether homework is truly effective.

A strong argument against homework is that its benefits depend heavily on the student's home environment. Children with quiet rooms and supportive parents may gain a great deal, while others struggle without help. For this reason, many writers suggest that schools should limit homework rather than ban it completely.

options: It helps students practise what they learn in class

options: Limit it rather than ban it completely
Give it only to older students

questions.text: Why might some children struggle with homework more than others?
options: They may lack the support or space needed to study
Their teachers refuse to help them
Homework is always harder for younger students

questions.text: What is the writers' main attitude toward homework?
options: They see it as useful but in need of limits
They think it should be removed from schools entirely
They believe it has no benefits at all
They are neutral and have no opinion

paragraph_translations: Em muitas escolas, os professores passam deveres de casa todas as noites. Os defensores argumentam que as tarefas ajudam os alunos a praticar o que aprendem em sala de aula e a desenvolver disciplina. No entanto, os críticos afirmam que trabalhos longos reduzem o tempo que as crianças precisam para descansar, praticar esportes e conviver com a família. Esse debate levou alguns especialistas em educação a questionar se os deveres de casa são realmente eficazes.

Um forte argumento contra os deveres de casa é que seus benefícios dependem muito do ambiente em que o aluno vive. Crianças com quartos silenciosos e pais que as apoiam podem ganhar muito, enquanto outras têm dificuldade sem ajuda. Por isso, muitos autores sugerem que as escolas limitem os deveres de casa, em vez de proibi-los completamente.
